posts.name: Brainsnaffler
posts.cooked:
Hello everyone

 

I have played Sentinels for just over a year now, and as I can see from the Forum, other people have had a similar idea to me.  I wanted to create more of a storytelling element to this already amazing game.  I spent a while putting together these PDF choose your own adventure campaigns that I wanted to post on the Forum for people to use and have fun with.  If you decide to play them or have a look, then I would really love any kind of feedback on how you thought they played, looked, and if you enjoyed them.

 

The links are below:-

 

The Revenge of Baron Blade

https://onedrive.live.com/redir?resid=958992069AEDA8DE!205&authkey=!AON4TLiIBq1ncBQ&ithint=file%2c.pdf

 

The Thorathian Invasion

https://onedrive.live.com/redir?resid=958992069AEDA8DE!206&authkey=!AKlxy7qXjtQvR-c&ithint=file%2c.pdf

 

Thank you everyone for taking the time to read this post, and thank you in anticipation of giving these campaigns a spin.

posts.name: Brainsnaffler
posts.cooked:
I designed the adventures based on the original cards, but so long as all your players are fine with it...why not?

 

I'm (slowly) working on a third one that deals with the formation of the Dark Watch, and in that, you start with the basic cards and "upgrade" to the Dark Wartch variants throughout the adventures.  It's pretty far from cannon (as are the adventures I attached on this thread), but it's just something fun and different.

 

Hope you enjoy them
